risk_note: RV2 by path (union adapters, test/spec). Shop names on product cards and in the detail summary: every adapter maps only its official shop-name field (taobao official search and detail item_basic_info.shop_title, dataoke shopName, JD shopInfo.shopName, PDD mall_name) through one rule shopNameField (trimmed, empty means absent, never filled from nick, title or shop id); card-assembler sets ProductCard.shop_name (null when absent) and product-reader's summary carries it. No amounts, quotes or links change.

reviews.note: Codex via tools/agent/codex-run.sh. Round 1 pass, no findings. Static, nothing executed.

spec_test_review.note: Rule tests by Codex (test/spec/catalog/shop-name, 14 tests; r3 fixed one import path that failed to load). Spec-test review by a fresh independent Claude context via tools/agent/claude-run.sh, round 1 pass, no findings. One frozen change (D10-639 甲, #24): test/spec/union/taobao-search/kit.ts ALLOWED_ITEM_KEYS gains the single entry 'shop_name' (the dataoke sample row carries shopName); every other line unchanged and mapping.test.ts:41 / :65 keep their exact per-key checks. The four files reading kit.ts were not in the red run's expected list (unchanged), so no red_exempt was needed.

longrun.note: no change under test/properties, packages/money, packages/domain or packages/testing; the required longrun-props check runs on the PR head
